title: Fe(II/III) colorimetric assay
author: Jian Gong
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd5fi83n

steps.title: Add reagent A and measure A1
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL of reagent A to 1.2 mL of filtered (or filtered‑diluted) sample or undiluted standard solution, mix gently by pipetting up and down a few times, then aliquot three 200 µL portions into a 96‑well plate and record absorbance A₁ immediately on the spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Add 120 µL reagent A to 1.2 mL sample/standard.
Mix by gentle pipetting up and down several times.
Aliquot three 200 µL portions into a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Reduce Fe(III) and measure A2
steps.instruction: Collect 640 µL of the remaining mixture from step 1, add 120 µL of reagent B, mix, start a timer, allow the reaction to proceed for exactly 10 minutes to reduce Fe(III) to Fe(II); at the 10‑minute mark add 40 µL of reagent C, mix, immediately aliquot three 200 µL portions into a 96‑well plate and record absorbance A₂.

substeps.instruction: Collect 640 µL of the remaining mixture.
Add 120 µL reagent B and mix.
Start timer; let react for 10 minutes.
At 10 min add 40 µL reagent C and mix.
Aliquot three 200 µL portions into a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Repeat reduction for standards and calculate α
steps.instruction: Perform the reduction procedure of step 2 one additional time only on the standard solutions, measure the resulting absorbance A₃, and compute the factor α (expected ≈ 0.8) together with its uncertainty.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the entire reduction sequence (collect 640 µL, add reagent B, wait 10 min, add reagent C) once more for each standard.
Measure absorbance A₃ using the same triplicate loading.
Calculate α from A₁, A₂, and A₃; α should be close to 0.8 and report its uncertainty.
